identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current iRobot US product pages. Roomba j7+, Roomba j9+, Braava jet m6 and Roomba Combo 10 Max are four separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and the existing iRobot company focus review was left unchanged. The reviewed pages publish robot mass, robot dimensions, battery type and, for the Combo 10 Max, battery capacity, so the catalog sizes and weights are replaced and the battery labels are replaced or cleared. The j7+ page publishes 799.99 USD and the Combo 10 Max page 1299.99 USD, while the j9+ and Braava jet m6 pages direct buyers to select retailers and publish no price, so the catalog 999 and 499 USD prices are cleared. Run times in minutes are published on none of the four pages, so the catalog 105, 120, 150 and 90 min values are cleared. The j7+ and Braava jet m6 pages publish no robot depth; their dimensions are recorded as published.

companyFocus.name: iRobot
companyFocus.role: Consumer robotic floor care and historical enterprise telepresence; prototype systems, non-robot appliances and dock/software roles separated
highlights: Selected primary releases distinguish historical Ava 500; 2025 Max 705 Combo; 2026 Max 875/775 Combo, Max 715 Vacuum, Plus 678/575/515/415 Combo and Mini; and the Duo prototype. This selection does not establish iRobot’s full historical cleaning, educational, defense or commercial robot portfolio.

The September 2026 release separates Max 875 suction 35,000 Pa/airflow 20 L/s from Plus 678 suction 30,000 Pa/18 L/s and the latter’s 40,000 Pa spray pretreatment. ThermaMist/DriLift/18 N/300 RPM and SprayForce/15 N/10 mm carpet lift remain model-specific; supplier comparisons retain their stated baselines.

Duo was unveiled as a prototype at IFA, with a main floor washer, deployment arm, Plus 575-based companion and shared mobile dock. The companion’s 8.35 cm height and 29.8 cm width are not complete Duo dimensions. No commercial Duo price or release is established.

The July 2026 North American release separately names Max 775, vacuum-only Max 715, Plus 575, Plus 515 and Plus 415 at dated MSRPs. Its Roomba Electro Plus is explicitly a user-operated non-robot cleaner and is not imported as an autonomous robot. Dock names, color variants and app/AI functions are not extra robot identities.

Plus 515 battery copy contradicts itself: 295 minutes versus about 10 hours. Both duration fields are left blank with conflicting evidence status. The 2,000 sq ft per-charge coverage is not a universal area rate; pad RPM, contact force, suction, roller extension and service intervals remain separate physical quantities.

Mini was already introduced in Japan in mid-February 2026 before the March 10 UK/European launch at€399/£379. Four colors are variants. Physical-button start without Wi-Fi is distinct from connected app/voice functions; disposable pads are distinct from AutoWash heated-roller care.

Ava 500’s March 2014 delivery statement and Cisco EX60/Aironet 1600 integration are historical. They do not establish present availability, support, safety/cleanroom certification or specifications of later Ava Robotics products. Current prices/stock, independent performance, exclusive USPs and market/search leadership remain unproven.
